title: Inverse design of a pyrochlore lattice of DNA origami through model-driven experiments
summary: Computationally designed interactions guide DNA origami into a pyrochlore lattice, verified by scattering and microscopy.
significance: Designed particle-interaction rules lead from computational models to an experimentally realized DNA-origami pyrochlore lattice. Small-angle X-ray scattering establishes its topology and long-range order; a silica-preserved crystal, imaged by electron microscopy, shows facets and surface pores that follow the designed lattice.
